title: Checks passed by the inner product proof
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean word of length $2m$ whose inner product modulo two is $1$, and form its proof by recording each coordinatewise product and each cumulative sum of those products. Then every seed check passes: the initial cumulative sum is $0$, the final one is $1$, each recorded product equals the product of the corresponding input bits, and consecutive cumulative sums differ by that recorded product modulo two.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $2m$
the inner product modulo two of $w$ is $1$
the seed is an allowed inner product linear check seed
